competency_fulfillment.rationale: Both halves of the competency are served and every key is arithmetically right: pupils identify equality by comparing a segment from 0 to 6 cm against one from 2 to 9 cm, and they plan a drawing by working out where a segment of a given length must end when it begins at a non-zero mark.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: Three distinct tasks are generated: judging whether two stated segments match, selecting from four described segments the one equal to a given length, and computing the terminal mark for a segment to be drawn. Both Yes and No outcomes occur in the judging items.

cognitive_capacity.rationale: Reading a segment as the difference between its two ruler marks is exactly the Grade 3 Quarter 1 measuring skill, all lengths are whole centimetres, and no segment extends past 14 cm so a standard school ruler suffices.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: Two of the drawing items place the start at the 0 cm mark, which collapses the task since the end mark simply restates the given length, and nothing in the set asks about equal sides on a figure or equal lengths on a real object. Only multiple choice and cloze appear.

competency_alignment.rationale: Difficulty increases by shifting the starting mark away from zero and by widening the gap between the candidate segments, both of which are the actual ruler skill rather than a substitute axis.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: Segment lengths run from 2 to 9 cm with no reading above 14 cm, matching the ruler a Grade 3 pupil uses and keeping every subtraction within basic facts.
